description: This file defines the SystemPresenceInfo enum which provides static methods to retrieve the last input activity in seconds and the primary IPv4 address, acting as a utility for system presence information.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IPv4 address using the NetworkInterfaces utility.
